benefit: Nasturtium is a strong trap crop for black bean aphid and green peach aphid. Heavily infested nasturtiums can be removed or sprayed to break the pest cycle while keeping the brassica clean.

members.title: Nasturtium border 2 weeks before brassica transplant
members.body: Direct-sow nasturtium on the border of the brassica block two weeks ahead of transplant so the trap is established and attractive when aphids arrive.
